worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.summary: Let the body burst open as a spreading mist: the ring blooms outward along the ground, dealing special damage to every non-ally around and stealing their sight, and the user faints; a lingering mist is left behind that keeps slowing enemies who stand in it. Used on misty terrain, the blast is stronger.
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.descrip: The mist ring deals %1$s special damage to every non-ally around the user.
The ring radius is %1$s blocks; it is also the move's real range and indicator circle.
Used while standing on misty terrain, the whole blast is ×%1$s.
Anyone caught loses their sight for %1$s.
The burst leaves a lingering mist, %1$s blocks across and lasting %2$s; enemies standing in it are continually slowed.
Wind-up %1$s, cooldown %2$s. Whether or not it hit anything, the user faints.
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.dense.o: Dense mist: lingering mist radius ×1.3, duration ×1.3, blindness +30 ticks, power ×0.92, wind-up +3, cooldown +10.
Thin burst: power ×1.08, lingering mist ×0.8, cooldown −6 — crisper and faster.
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.use.0: Trade one life for a blinding ring when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.use.1: Detonate harder while standing in mist
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.use.2: Turn a patch of ground into lingering slowing mist
worldcombat.skill.mistyexplosion.prefere: On (dense mist): lingering mist radius ×1.3, duration ×1.3, blindness +30 ticks, but the blast is ×0.92, wind-up +3 and cooldown +10 — trades one burst for a whole field of sustained control. Off (thin burst): power ×1.08, lingering mist ×0.8 — crisper and faster. Either way the user faints.
Beyond this distance the companion first closes in rather than detonating; this is a move for a tight ring.
How many visible, living targets must be inside the ring before detonating. Higher saves it for being surrounded; at 1 it fires on a single target.
Below this health fraction the detonation count drops to 1. Higher makes the companion go all-in sooner.
From level %1$s the blast gains another step (power about %2$s, radius about %3$s).
world_combat.move.mistyexplosion.text.mi: The mist only covered the ground
